sections.words: My Blog All Posts What led me here: beginning my tantra practice March 24, 2023 One day I woke up and things felt completely different. The nice apartment, the new car, the well paying corporate job. Nothing felt like it fit, none of it was what I had thought I wanted. This feeling arose in me directly after I had a Kundalini awakening. This happened to be after I met this guy.. it was a date with destiny without question. We had sex after hanging a few times, and it shot me out of my body into a beam of light where I was connected to my body yet I was so much MORE. And I also happen to see visions of his dreams as I came back into my body fully. Then to find out, after I'm perplexed beyond comprehension, that he had done Ayahuasca a few months prior and I was the first person he had penetrated since that. I had to figure out what this event was and how to have another experience like that. I was hooked. And specifically, I was hooked on him, thinking he was the one drug that I could take and continue to get high (literally!) I started read anything about the subject I could get my hands on, but at that moment it was pretty limited. Something had to give. I had a flash of enlightenment from that experience, and soon before that I learned how to meditate. This lasted a few months, and then a crash. Impending reality came tumbling in like that first day after. Except I couldn't escape the feeling when I was alone. It felt like the lights went out and I was stuck in the dark. Then marijuana came a primary source of that high feeling. I was pulling on a hash pen multiple times a day. Then there was a huge birthday celebration with coworkers and we all went out with lots of alcohol and coke. I was sticking mostly to the hash. Late into the night when things were winding down, I went to go check on a guy there that I had sex with a prior to that night. As soon as he touched me, it was lightening. We were all over the place, and finally when I landed on top, it happened again. I started to shoot out of my body, only this time he nearly threw me across the room! He was really distraught as to what happened, and I quickly left the room. This left me wondering... it happened twice with two different men. Then this has to be something that can be recreated. I was focused on the need of it, that's mostly how I'm wired, a needy whore ;) Another way I'm wired is this distinct pull on my heart, it's really the call of the heart. I've become very acute to listening and following that. It brought me to Boulder when my entire life fell apart after that in the dark period. When I arrived in Boulder I was practically homeless, sleeping on couches and very sure my heart lead me there. Soon after I met the person that changed the course of my life forever. J leads ecstatic dance and invited me to a class when I was at my lowest. I show up the following day excited that someone invited me to something that was new & scary yet I felt so welcomed. They gave me yellow roses at the beginning of the class and I really fell in love in a way I hadn't ever experienced. We had the best of times following that. J taught me how to create sacred space and set up ceremony in a way that was profound and intentional. I received shamanic extractions or also known as psychic surgery, that significantly helped my body feel lighter. It was at this point in the journey that I became aware of just how much trauma was stored in the body. The body definitely keeps score of things that aren't processed and resolved. I started hosting sessions at this time, it started with sensual massage and once I met J it shifted. I would practice new techniques with clients after I had a session with J. We would dive into my personal work and from that I found new ways of working with energy & I wanted to share it with clients. This went on for over 2 years, then I met a man who's called a daka or a male sexual healer. We ended up living together and had a deep dive into tantric sex for over 6 weeks. This work with him was so profound for me because it was the embodied practice of my work for those years prior. It was my sexual liberation experience! Now I'm here wanting to share this tantric work with those that feel like it's the heart's calling. sections.words: My Blog All Posts What led me here: beginning my tantra practice March 24, 2023 One day I woke up and things felt completely different. The nice apartment, the new car, the well paying corporate job. Nothing felt like it fit, none of it was what I had thought I wanted. This feeling arose in me directly after I had a Kundalini awakening. This happened to be after I met this guy.. it was a date with destiny without question. We had sex after hanging a few times, and it shot me out of my body into a beam of light where I was connected to my body yet I was so much MORE. And I also happen to see visions of his dreams as I came back into my body fully. Then to find out, after I'm perplexed beyond comprehension, that he had done Ayahuasca a few months prior and I was the first person he had penetrated since that. I had to figure out what this event was and how to have another experience like that. I was hooked. And specifically, I was hooked on him, thinking he was the one drug that I could take and continue to get high (literally!) I started read anything about the subject I could get my hands on, but at that moment it was pretty limited. Something had to give. I had a flash of enlightenment from that experience, and soon before that I learned how to meditate. This lasted a few months, and then a crash. Impending reality came tumbling in like that first day after. Except I couldn't escape the feeling when I was alone. It felt like the lights went out and I was stuck in the dark. Then marijuana came a primary source of that high feeling. I was pulling on a hash pen multiple times a day. Then there was a huge birthday celebration with coworkers and we all went out with lots of alcohol and coke. I was sticking mostly to the hash. Late into the night when things were winding down, I went to go check on a guy there that I had sex with a prior to that night. As soon as he touched me, it was lightening. We were all over the place, and finally when I landed on top, it happened again. I started to shoot out of my body, only this time he nearly threw me across the room! He was really distraught as to what happened, and I quickly left the room. This left me wondering... it happened twice with two different men. Then this has to be something that can be recreated. I was focused on the need of it, that's mostly how I'm wired, a needy whore ;) Another way I'm wired is this distinct pull on my heart, it's really the call of the heart. I've become very acute to listening and following that. It brought me to Boulder when my entire life fell apart after that in the dark period. When I arrived in Boulder I was practically homeless, sleeping on couches and very sure my heart lead me there. Soon after I met the person that changed the course of my life forever. J leads ecstatic dance and invited me to a class when I was at my lowest. I show up the following day excited that someone invited me to something that was new & scary yet I felt so welcomed. They gave me yellow roses at the beginning of the class and I really fell in love in a way I hadn't ever experienced. We had the best of times following that. J taught me how to create sacred space and set up ceremony in a way that was profound and intentional. I received shamanic extractions or also known as psychic surgery, that significantly helped my body feel lighter. It was at this point in the journey that I became aware of just how much trauma was stored in the body. The body definitely keeps score of things that aren't processed and resolved. I started hosting sessions at this time, it started with sensual massage and once I met J it shifted. I would practice new techniques with clients after I had a session with J. We would dive into my personal work and from that I found new ways of working with energy & I wanted to share it with clients. This went on for over 2 years, then I met a man who's called a daka or a male sexual healer. We ended up living together and had a deep dive into tantric sex for over 6 weeks. This work with him was so profound for me because it was the embodied practice of my work for those years prior. It was my sexual liberation experience! Now I'm here wanting to share this tantric work with those that feel like it's the heart's calling. This is my initiation story, what's yours? beginning tantra begin tantra practice beginning tantric sex Share this post: Recent Posts What is it to BE? Awareness, presence & love Dec 24, 2022
